correctness.rationale: Character orthogonality on image subspaces yields exact incidence sums H_0,H_1,H_2 and a verifiable Fourier polynomial. Rank-shell counts and Fourier inversion give the exact sharp norms and inversion. Independent complete Walsh and ternary character calculations confirm low-dimensional instances without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial determinantal (Segre secant) rank ball has a natural Fourier-projection norm and convolution-invertibility question. Its complete universal sign pattern and characteristic-two square transition have mathematical content beyond raw eigenvalue tables; the norm collapses from an m+1-term absolute-value sum to one or two explicitly counted shells, giving exact sharp constants for an infinite family.
